products.name: NIVIS Bright Glutathione Face Wash
products.subtitle: NIVIS Bright Glutathione Face Wash is a gentle yet effective facial cleanser formulated to remove dirt, excess oil, and daily impurities while helping to maintain a fresh and radiant complexion. Enriched with Glutathione, it helps support brighter-looking skin and promotes a clean, refreshed feel after every wash. Its nourishing formula cleanses without over-drying, making it suitable for daily use and all skin types.
